name: KG finding executor drain (apply or escalate)
notes: [Re-enabled 2026-06-09 alongside kg_finding_backlog_drain -- the 2026-05-10 POST-NUKE pause is over (pipeline rebuilt, scanner live since 2026-05-12; the two drains were missed by 5d1356ba). 24h grace + revertible merges (kg_merge_log / unmerge) remain the safety net.] Drains the executor bucket every 15 min. Picks up investigated findings whose 24h dev-page grace window has expired AND user-Accepted findings (the /accept endpoint backdates investigated_at past the grace gate as a queue signal). Filters to disposition='auto_apply'; 'needs_user_review' findings stay in the user queue. Hands each to kg_resolution_manager which reads the recommendation prose and applies the matching mutations from its full mutator suite (merge/delete/update/etc.). Closes the self-healing loop: pending -> investigated -> executed (mutations applied) | escalated (planner couldn't operationalize) | dismissed (take_action=False short-circuit). For instant drain without waiting up to 15 min, hit POST /api/routines/kg_finding_executor_drain/run-now (the 'Run executor now' button on /kg-maintenance/investigated).
